name: Assassin at Crimson Keep
source: Assassin at Crimson Keep is a short visual novel set in a dark, quasi-fantasy world. After a botched assassination attempt, you pursue the King into his lair known as the Crimson Keep. Your small choices can have great consequences, either for good or for evil.
translation: 《Assassin at Crimson Keep》是一部短篇视觉小说，舞台是一个阴暗、略带奇幻色彩的世界。一次刺杀行动失败后，你追着国王来到他的巢穴“绯红堡垒”。微小的选择，也可能带来巨大的后果，无论是好是坏。
